skill_frontmatter.name: wangbin-tender-analyzer
skill_frontmatter.description: 对照已授权招标文本、正式补遗和响应稿，检查漏答、附件证据及版本冲突；保留单文件分析。
skill_frontmatter.description_zh: 对照招标要求、正式补遗和响应材料，检查漏答、附件证据与版本冲突。
skill_frontmatter.description_en: Check bid responses against tender requirements and formal amendments, identifying omissions, missing evidence, and version conflicts.
examples_zh: 这是招标文本和拟提交的响应稿，帮我检查漏答、缺证明材料和前后不一致的地方。
对照正式补遗重新核查标书，指出哪些响应还沿用了旧要求。
根据附件清单检查提交材料，只有名字但没有实际证据的项目单独列出来。
examples_en: Check this tender and draft response for omissions, missing evidence, and inconsistencies.
Recheck the response against the formal amendments and identify sections that still use superseded requirements.
Check the submission against the attachment list and separate listed filenames from evidence that is actually available.
